parsed.name: IEEE 488.2 通用实验室仪器
parsed.description: 符合 IEEE 488.2 标准的通用实验室测试仪器，可通过标准公共命令完成设备识别、复位、自检、触发、状态寄存器管理以及仪器状态的保存与恢复。此类设备常见于各类台式电子测量仪器中。
parsed.description_en: A generic laboratory test instrument compliant with the IEEE 488.2 standard. It supports standard common commands for identification, reset, self-test, triggering, status register handling, and instrument state save/recall. This device class is commonly found in bench electronic test instruments.

actions.description: 异步清除状态寄存器并清空错误队列
actions.description_en: Asynchronously clear the status registers and error queue.

actions.description: 异步从指定非易失存储位置恢复仪器状态
actions.description_en: Asynchronously recall the instrument state from the specified non-volatile memory location.

actions.description: 异步将仪器复位到出厂默认上电状态
actions.description_en: Asynchronously reset the instrument to its factory default power-up state.

actions.description: 异步将当前仪器状态保存到指定非易失存储位置
actions.description_en: Asynchronously save the current instrument state to the specified non-volatile memory location.

actions.description: 异步执行完整自检
actions.description_en: Asynchronously perform a complete self-test.

actions.description: 异步设置“操作完成”位，使当前操作结束后置位标准事件寄存器
actions.description_en: Asynchronously set the Operation Complete bit so it is asserted in the Standard Event Register when the current operation finishes.

actions.description: 异步触发仪器执行一次触发操作
actions.description_en: Asynchronously trigger the instrument to perform a trigger event.

actions.description: 异步等待前序操作完成后再继续执行
actions.description_en: Asynchronously wait for the preceding operation to complete before continuing.

actions.description: 异步等待全部挂起命令完成并返回操作完成指示
actions.description_en: Asynchronously wait until all pending commands complete and return an operation-complete indication.

actions.description: 读取已安装选件信息
actions.description_en: Read the installed option information.

actions.description_en: Perform a complete self-test.

actions.description_en: Wait for the preceding operation to complete before continuing.

actions.description: 触发仪器执行一次触发操作
actions.description_en: Trigger the instrument to perform a trigger event.

actions.description: 读取状态字节
actions.description_en: Read the status byte.

actions.description: 获取或设置服务请求使能寄存器
actions.description_en: Get or set the service request enable register.
